name: Byōdō-in Temple Garden
heritage: Place of Scenic Beauty; Historic Site of Japan

depictions.name: Byodoin Temple
depictions.text: Byōdō-in Byodoin Temple (平等院) is a Buddhist temple situated near Ogura Pond in Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. It was formerly part of Yamashiro Province during the Sengoku period.
